name: Wanted: Maggot Eye
summary: Wanted: Maggot Eye is an official death bounty posted on the Brill notice board by the town's Forsaken leadership. A notorious gnoll has been looting nearby graveyards and farms to supply dead bodies directly to the Lich King's Scourge. Executor Zygand requires proof of the creature's execution to secure the lands around Garren's Haunt.

sections.title: A Grave Crime
sections.body: In Tirisfal Glades, the dead are far from resting peacefully. The gnoll known as Maggot Eye earned a severe death sentence not merely for scavenging, but for active collaboration with the Lich King. While gnolls are generally viewed as savage brutes driven by simple hunger, Maggot Eye has been systematically digging up corpses and collecting remains to fuel the ranks of the Scourge army.

sections.title: Justice in Brill
sections.body: For the Forsaken, whose entire existence hinges on breaking free from the Lich King's dominion, feeding dead kin back into the Scourge war machine is among the highest offenses possible. Executor Zygand, overseeing local military enforcement in Brill, commissioned this bounty to put an end to the grave robberies near Garren's Haunt. To collect the prize, the executioner must sever Maggot Eye's paw as unmistakable proof that the beast will trouble Tirisfal no longer.

faq.answer: Maggot Eye is an infamous gnoll prowling the northern regions of Tirisfal Glades. Considered vile even among his kind, he pillages the farms near Garren's Haunt and gathers corpses for the Scourge.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken want him dead?
faq.answer: He was sentenced to death for directly supplying freshly looted corpses to the Lich King's Scourge army. Denying soldiers and resources to the Scourge is essential to Forsaken survival.

faq.q: Where is Maggot Eye usually found?
faq.answer: He can be found lurking inside an old ruined hut in Garren's Haunt, a ruined farmstead located to the north of Brill.

faq.q: Who pays the reward for the bounty?
faq.answer: Executor Zygand in the center of Brill accepts proof of the kill and distributes the town's reward on behalf of the Forsaken military authority.

faq.q: Why does Executor Zygand want his paw?
faq.answer: In classic frontier justice, taking a unique physical trophy like Maggot Eye's paw ensures indisputable proof of death before the bounty funds are paid out.

faq.q: Are gnolls allied with the Scourge?
aliases: do gnolls work for lich king
faq.answer: Generally gnolls act independently out of hunger and greed, but Maggot Eye specifically trades or funnels dead bodies to the Scourge, making him an exceptionally dangerous collaborator.

angles.text: Every corpse stolen by Maggot Eye is a fallen sibling turned back into an enslaved puppet of the Lich King. Putting him down is a matter of both national defense and personal vengeance.
Tirisfal's northern borders must be pacified if the Horde is to maintain a secure foothold in Lordaeron against remnants of the Scourge.
